data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Safaa’, meaning purity. Masoomah refers to someone who is innocent, pure, and untainted. In Islamic tradition, Masoomah is also used to refer to the wives of Prophet Muhammad PBUH. The name Masoomah carries the meaning “Innocent, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masoomah usually hope their child will grow to embody innocent, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Masoomah is an Arabic name with a rich cultural history in Islamic tradition. It is a name that embodies the ideals of innocence and purity, which are highly valued virtues in Islamic society. The name took on an additional significance when it was used to refer to the wives of Prophet Muhammad PBUH - Aisha, Hudhayfah, Safiyyah, Umm Salama, and Zainab. These women were revered for their unwavering faith and commitment to Islam, and their names became synonyms for virtue and purity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Masoomah holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It serves as a reminder of the importance of leading a pure and innocent life, free from sin and worldly desires. The name encapsulates the essence of spiritual purity, which is essential for gaining closeness to Allah SWT. By using the name Masoomah, individuals seek to embody the characteristics of innocence and purity, striving to live in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad PBUH and the Quran. The name also serves as a source of inspiration, encouraging individuals to continuously strive for righteousness and spiritual growth.
